name: Sanctions Facilitators and Professional Enablers
description: Lawyers, accountants, trust and company service providers, brokers and other professionals may knowingly or unknowingly structure transactions, set up entities or move funds to help designated persons avoid sanctions. Indicators focus on unusual service patterns, pass-through behaviour and the enabler's own risk profile.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance on Beneficial Ownership of Legal Persons (2023)
OFAC and UK government advisories on sanctions evasion enablers (general reference)

indicators.name: Service provider incorporates many entities for related clients with shared structures
indicators.canon: Adviser or agent acting for multiple linked clients
indicators.desc: A single provider, broker, lawyer or agent sets up entities or handles transactions for many related clients with similar structures.
indicators.ctx: Same provider sets up numerous similar entities for linked beneficial owners.

indicators.name: Professional's client account used as pass-through
indicators.canon: Professional client account used as pass-through
indicators.desc: A professional's client account is used to move funds with no underlying legal or advisory work.
indicators.ctx: Funds enter and leave client accounts of an adviser with no related service.
indicators.fp: Client accounts are used for legitimate settlements.

indicators.name: Advisers instructed to use complex structures after a customer's designation risk emerges
indicators.canon: Advisers instructed to use complex structures after a customer's designation risk emerges
indicators.desc: Request for restructuring after adverse news or risk of designation.
indicators.ctx: Request for restructuring after adverse news or risk of designation.

indicators.name: Facilitator relying on informal channels, cash or trade offsets for clients
indicators.canon: Facilitator relying on informal channels, cash or trade offsets for clients
indicators.desc: Payments for clients via netting, barter or unrecorded transfers.
indicators.ctx: Payments for clients via netting, barter or unrecorded transfers.
indicators.fp: Informal systems are used in some communities.

indicators.name: Provider with disciplinary history or enforcement exposure
indicators.canon: Prior regulatory, criminal or enforcement history
indicators.desc: Customer or principal has previous convictions, enforcement or disciplinary action, or has been exited by another institution.
indicators.ctx: Adverse regulatory or enforcement actions concerning sanctions handling.

indicators.name: Provider acts for many clients from the same higher-risk jurisdiction
indicators.canon: Provider acts for many clients from the same higher-risk jurisdiction

indicators.name: Fee arrangements disproportionate to services or paid by third parties
indicators.canon: Fee arrangements disproportionate to services or paid by third parties

indicators.name: Document or sanction-licence irregularities
indicators.desc: Applications or licence reliance appear inconsistent or altered.
